name: error-filter-null-value
$comment: Null edge on the filter VALUE: a comparison leaf whose value is JSON null is rejected with BAD_REQUEST before execution — the SQL compile path accepts only string/number/boolean comparison values ("filter value must be a string, number, or boolean"), so Eq-null is not a way to match absent fields (use Not(Exists) instead). Derived from server query/filter.rs jsonb_lhs_and_bind + validate_jsonb_comparison_value; an engine that lazily evaluates Eq-null to no-match instead of rejecting diverges from the server.
